$comment: Portal navigation sections for the 'public' audience. Order here is the order Scalar renders them. A tag's section comes from the x-domain extension its owning service emits; every surface now does, so there is no tagDomains fallback here. A tag the composer cannot place from x-domain is a hard failure -- add x-domain in the owning service rather than reintroducing a fallback, or the section a tag belongs to stops being owned by the team that owns the routes.
